# From a built slice, exploratory test

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

When the user asks for startup options, that ask names only `$crav1-spark-to-spec`, `$crav1-ideas-to-spec`, `$crav1-bundle-to-specs`, `$crav1-existing-to-specs`, `$crav1-read-environment`, and `$crav1-fix-bug`.

That stop is named `matched the first pass`. That stop is named `the user said stop`.

A bug it finds is not sent to `$crav1-fix-bug` unless the user says so in that turn.

## First prompt

```text
$crav1-run-exploratory-test
@docs/specs/<slug>/

Use the slice once, then again with randomness. Write down bugs. Do not start Specify, Plan, or Build.
```

## Steps

| Phase | You | Agent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Slice | Named the slice, or pick from the slices that have a build | Stops when no slice has a build. Does not start Build |
| Pass one | — | Uses the slice once and counts the actions. Learns how the slice works |
| Pass two | — | No longer careful. Sometimes a double-click, a hover back and forth, a repeated action, or the same control more than once. Follows what the last action showed |
| Stop | Say stop to end sooner | Stops when the second pass has gone on about as long as the first. The stop name is `matched the first pass`. The user saying stop ends it sooner. That stop name is `the user said stop`. The user does not set a clock |
| Bugs | Read `explore.md` | Writes what broke. Leaves the plan’s checks in the plan |

## What gets written

`docs/specs/<slug>/explore.md` in the slice folder that already exists.

No `spec.md` edit. No `plan.md` edit. No `tasks.md` edit. No `verify.md` edit.

## After

`Run next: nothing needed now.` A bug stays in `explore.md`. Send a bug to `$crav1-fix-bug` only in a turn where the user says so. When the file changed: `Uncommitted: 1 file; commit with $crav1-finalize-commit when ready.` See [How a run ends](reference/run-ending.md).
